entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: Praises and all divine worship, to be acceptable to God, must flow from the heart, and be the offspring of sincere and upright devotion to his holy service.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: Thou hast rebuked the heathen; the nations that know not God. These words are spoken by prophetic anticipation.  They describe the final issue of God's judgments upon his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments:
Destructions; those caused by the wicked; they and their works perish together.  But we may better render, As to the enemy, [his] destructions are completed for ever; that is, he is completely destroyed for ever. 
 
Though the wicked may flourish for a time, and succeed in their projects against the righteous, they are destined to complete and everlasting disappointment.

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments:
Know thy name; are acquainted with the manifestations which thou hast made of thyself. 
 
Those who are acquainted with the manifestations of God, especially in the person and work of his Son, will in all times of trouble flee to him as their refuge; and in seeking him as their chief good, they will not want any good thing.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: In Zion; in his sanctuary, or among his redeemed people.

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: The righteous desire salvation, that the praise of their deliverance from Satan, sin, and death, and of their preparation for heavenly glory, may be given to God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: In the net which they hid; for the purpose of taking the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments:
The judgment which he executeth; on the wicked. 
 
  Higgaion; this word is rendered "solemn sound,"
.  It seems to denoted an instrumental interlude of some kind, while the voices of the singers rested.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: The poor and the needy may for a time seem to be forgotten, and may be called to exercise long patience; but let them trust in the Lord, and in the end they will see that they have always been remembered, and their highest hopes will be more than realized.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them; that is, the wicked persecutors spoken of in the preceding verses.
